cast.owner: the barber in his sixties with a grey pompadour, a neat white beard and a navy barber smock
cast.rival: the young influencer with bleached spiky hair in a shiny silver tracksuit
cast.regular: the retired mail carrier with a big grey moustache in a tan windbreaker
cast.hero1: the muscular bearded man with wavy dark hair in a black t-shirt with thin green stripes
cast.hero2: the muscular man with short curly dark hair and a thin moustache in a plain black t-shirt

slots.place: the old corner barbershop with a red-and-white barber pole
slots.counter: the vintage barber chair by the big mirror
slots.rival_place: chrome mega-salon with a giant spinning razor on the roof
slots.busy: Customers wait on the bench reading newspapers while clippers buzz and a hot towel steams.
slots.unsold: A row of empty waiting chairs and a stack of untouched hot towels.
slots.regular_line: Same as always. Don't you ever change this place.
slots.offer_item: The vintage barber chair stands empty and ready with a clean cape folded on it, in plain view.
slots.offer_action: pats the empty barber chair and says kindly
slots.offer_line: Chair's open. First cut's on the house.
slots.taste_setup: {hero1} sits in the barber chair with a fresh sharp cut, the cape still on; {hero2} stands beside, curious.
slots.taste: checks the fresh cut in the mirror: a silent stunned beat, mouth closed, running a hand over it
slots.bad_idea_line: Okay. Ideas. A dancing razor mascot? Glitter fade Fridays?
slots.good_idea_line: ...No. This should have a line around the block.
slots.heirloom: an old straight razor in a small glass case and a framed black-and-white photo of the shop on opening day
slots.heirloom_line: My father's razor. Fifty years in this chair.
slots.craft: giving a careful straight-razor shave with a hot towel
slots.craft_line: Don't look at us. Look at the razor.
slots.old_car: the old rusty green pickup truck
slots.payoff: a glossy cherry-red original vintage-style coupe with whitewall tires, no badges, no emblems and no plate text
